chunks: And he عليه السلام said to Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār:
When you carry the sides of the bier, the bier of the deceased, you come out from sins just as your mother gave birth to you.

key_terms.أُمُّكَ: your mother, used here in the simile of newborn purity
key_terms.الذُّنُوبِ: sins from which one is purified
key_terms.السَّرِيرِ: the bier or funeral couch of the deceased
key_terms.جَوَانِبَ: the sides or handles by which the bier is carried

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for carrying the bier of a deceased person in Islamic funeral rites?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the spiritual merit of participating in the funeral rites of a deceased believer by carrying the bier. It emphasizes that this act is a means of forgiveness, such that a person is purified from sins like a newborn from his mother.
